method: 동결된 두 별도 AI 원문 초안의 사실·상태·관계를 고정 정책과 제공 windows로 심사했다. 원문과 단일 window 안의 사건 범위가 채택 근거다. 다수결·일치 여부·대상 모델 결과·점수는 근거로 사용하지 않았다. 표면 형태가 달라도 원문 밖 alias·정규화는 만들지 않았으며 근거 없는 관계는 채점에서 제외했다.

document_scope_decisions.source_decision: 시험비행 완료와 성능은 물리 제품 탐색이다. 시험기 two, 비행시간, payload 성능을 상업 공급·납기·물량으로 승인하지 않는다.
첫 window의 실제 CASSIOPÉE 계약과 둘째 window의 제품별 will 공급을 분리한다. 네 구체 시스템 대상은 공급 PLAN으로 보존하고, 범위 밖 DGA·France·SIGINT는 승인하지 않는다. 기존 CO3D 사용은 탐색이다.
수주 자체는 ACTUAL DEMAND_INCREASE이고 25-year는 계약기간이다. 두 공급자 이름을 보존한다. 별도 window의 Once deployed·미래 기능·미래 인증을 현재 수주 사건에 전이하지 않는다.
회사 인수와 소프트웨어 제품 기능 설명이다. QShield 이름은 발견으로 보존하되 신규 물리 제품 수급 사건은 없다.
재무 발표·웹캐스트·녹화 다운로드 일정이다. 제품 사건이 없다.
수상한 발전소 프로젝트와 일반 기업 소개다. LNG·electricity는 발견으로만 남기며 수상·일반 delivery 표현을 신규 물량 변화로 만들지 않는다.
교육·장학금이며 인원·나이·교육시간·지원금을 제품 물량이나 고객으로 바꾸지 않는다.
배당과 기업 소개다. 금융 지급 시점·금액은 electricity 사건이 아니다.
실제 MoU 체결과 미래 reactor deployment는 다르다. 배치 플랫폼 설명 window 하나에서 가능한 사실만 승인한다. 물리 공급 증가 방향·고객·적격 공급자 관계는 미해결로 유지한다.
July 2026 생산 기록과 현재 transport relief는 다른 사건이다. pipeline infrastructure는 별도 물리 대상이고 Hugh Brinson은 운영 프로젝트명이다. gas와 LNG를 합치지 않는다.
첫 반기 수출 기록, 10년 propane 생산 증가, upstream natural gas output 성장은 제품·기간·단계가 달라 보존한다. 본문의 record export levels를 두 번째 수출 사건으로 중복하지 않는다. Asia는 가격 비교이며 crude oil은 부산물 경로의 탐색이다.
slower pace여도 electricity use increasing은 증가다. 신규 EV 판매 감소와 기존 EV 등록 stock 2%는 다른 분모·기간이다. 후자는 탐색으로 남긴다. 종료된 공제를 현재 완화로 채택하지 않는다. U.S. headline·body 모집단의 범위 밖 사실을 전이하지 않는다.
세 차량 기종은 분리한다. 제목과 본문의 동일 판매 기사를 두 사건으로 세지 않는다. 본문 시장점유율 증감과 절대 대수 수요 방향은 다르므로 역할은 AMBIGUOUS다. 합산 24/22%는 개별 기종에 배분하지 않고 탐색으로 보존한다. 일반 에너지원 소비 기능은 새 수요 사건이 아니다.
공개기업의 기존 생산 구조·상대 비용 우위다. most와 higher volumes를 신규 증산으로 만들지 않는다.
Stage 3의 December 2024 생산 개시와 시설 전체의 확장 후 nominal/peak ratings는 다른 시간·측정 범위로 구분한다. 제목은 body 확장 사건의 반복이고 Sabine Pass는 기존 비교치다. 정격 능력을 실제 적격 생산 유량으로 바꾸지 않는다.
미국 전체 record 전망과 Permian 지역 정량 전망은 별도 주장이다. FORECAST를 ACTUAL로 바꾸지 않고 2025는 비교 기준, 2026은 전망 기간이다.
global distillate 감산, 미국산 수출 수요 증가, 실제 수출 유량 증가를 분리한다. heating oil이 집합에 포함된다고 하위 제품 독립 감산을 확정하지 않는다.
distillate 전체 tightness·감산과 diesel 수출 수요 증가는 별개다. diesel 포함 문구만으로 하위 제품의 독립 감산을 확정하지 않는다. 세 감산 지역을 각각 literal로 보존한다.
실제 agreement 발표와 향후 oil 생산 PLAN을 구분한다. 투자금·단위 비용은 물량이 아니다. 2026은 기준 연도이고 next five years는 투자 기간으로 생산 준비일과의 동일성이 미해결이다.
수상자·연구 분야·사이트명이다. 제품 수급 사건이 없다.

reference.quote:
The New Clean Vehicle Credit and Qualified Commercial Clean Vehicle Credit , which reduced the cost to buy and lease new electric vehicles, ended on September 30, 2025. In 1H26, new electric vehicle sales were down 19% compared with 2H25. New electric vehicle sales are relatively small compared with the total number of vehicles on the road. In 2024, the most recent year of available data, electric vehicles accounted for 2% of all registered light-duty vehicles in the United States.
Our electric vehicle electricity consumption data are estimates for on-road, light-duty vehicles that weigh less than or equal to 8,500 pounds. We do not collect these data on our traditional surveys. Instead, we estimate electric vehicle electricity use with a recently finalized model based on external data sources. Going forward we will continue to estimate these data series in our Monthly Energy Review and State Energy Data System .

reference.quote: By comparison, hybrid electric vehicles consume liquid fuels and do not connect to the grid.

In the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26), 24% of new light-duty vehicles sold in the United States were hybrid electric, battery electric, or plug-in hybrid electric vehicles, up from 22% in 2Q25. Between 2Q25 and 2Q26, hybrid electric vehicles continued to gain market share, reaching a record 16% of light-duty vehicle sales. The market shares of battery electric and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles decreased, according to estimates from Omdia. In 2Q26, battery electric vehicle sales were 6% of new light-duty vehicles sold, down from 7% in 2Q25; plug-in hybrid electric vehicle sales fell from 1.9% to 1.4% over the same period.
These different vehicle types affect the broader energy sector in different ways. Battery electric and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles can consume electricity from the grid, which affects electricity demand. By comparison, hybrid electric vehicles consume liquid fuels and do not connect to the grid. Hybrid vehicles were not eligible for any of the federal tax credits that expired in September 2025.

CCL Stage 3 , which started producing LNG in December 2024, is part of the larger Corpus Christi LNG Terminal in San Patricio County, Texas. reviewer_reference.quote:
In the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26), 24% of new light-duty vehicles sold in the United States were hybrid electric, battery electric, or plug-in hybrid electric vehicles, up from 22% in 2Q25. Between 2Q25 and 2Q26, hybrid electric vehicles continued to gain market share, reaching a record 16% of light-duty vehicle sales. The market shares of battery electric and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles decreased, according to estimates from Omdia. In 2Q26, battery electric vehicle sales were 6% of new light-duty vehicles sold, down from 7% in 2Q25; plug-in hybrid electric vehicle sales fell from 1.9% to 1.4% over the same period.
These different vehicle types affect the broader energy sector in different ways. Battery electric and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles can consume electricity from the grid, which affects electricity demand. By comparison, hybrid electric vehicles consume liquid fuels and do not connect to the grid. Hybrid vehicles were not eligible for any of the federal tax credits that expired in September 2025.

In the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26), 24% of new light-duty vehicles sold in the United States were hybrid electric, battery electric, or plug-in hybrid electric vehicles, up from 22% in 2Q25. Between 2Q25 and 2Q26, hybrid electric vehicles continued to gain market share, reaching a record 16% of light-duty vehicle sales. The market shares of battery electric and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles decreased, according to estimates from Omdia. In 2Q26, battery electric vehicle sales were 6% of new light-duty vehicles sold, down from 7% in 2Q25; plug-in hybrid electric vehicle sales fell from 1.9% to 1.4% over the same period.
These different vehicle types affect the broader energy sector in different ways. Battery electric and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles can consume electricity from the grid, which affects electricity demand. By comparison, hybrid electric vehicles consume liquid fuels and do not connect to the grid. Hybrid vehicles were not eligible for any of the federal tax credits that expired in September 2025.

In the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26), 24% of new light-duty vehicles sold in the United States were hybrid electric, battery electric, or plug-in hybrid electric vehicles, up from 22% in 2Q25. Between 2Q25 and 2Q26, hybrid electric vehicles continued to gain market share, reaching a record 16% of light-duty vehicle sales. The market shares of battery electric and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles decreased, according to estimates from Omdia. In 2Q26, battery electric vehicle sales were 6% of new light-duty vehicles sold, down from 7% in 2Q25; plug-in hybrid electric vehicle sales fell from 1.9% to 1.4% over the same period.
These different vehicle types affect the broader energy sector in different ways. Battery electric and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles can consume electricity from the grid, which affects electricity demand. By comparison, hybrid electric vehicles consume liquid fuels and do not connect to the grid. Hybrid vehicles were not eligible for any of the federal tax credits that expired in September 2025.

In the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26), 24% of new light-duty vehicles sold in the United States were hybrid electric, battery electric, or plug-in hybrid electric vehicles, up from 22% in 2Q25. Between 2Q25 and 2Q26, hybrid electric vehicles continued to gain market share, reaching a record 16% of light-duty vehicle sales. The market shares of battery electric and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles decreased, according to estimates from Omdia. In 2Q26, battery electric vehicle sales were 6% of new light-duty vehicles sold, down from 7% in 2Q25; plug-in hybrid electric vehicle sales fell from 1.9% to 1.4% over the same period.

By comparison, hybrid electric vehicles consume liquid fuels and do not connect to the grid. Hybrid vehicles were not eligible for any of the federal tax credits that expired in September 2025.

reference.quote:
In the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26), 24% of new light-duty vehicles sold in the United States were hybrid electric, battery electric, or plug-in hybrid electric vehicles, up from 22% in 2Q25. Between 2Q25 and 2Q26, hybrid electric vehicles continued to gain market share, reaching a record 16% of light-duty vehicle sales. The market shares of battery electric and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles decreased, according to estimates from Omdia. In 2Q26, battery electric vehicle sales were 6% of new light-duty vehicles sold, down from 7% in 2Q25; plug-in hybrid electric vehicle sales fell from 1.9% to 1.4% over the same period.
These different vehicle types affect the broader energy sector in different ways. Battery electric and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles can consume electricity from the grid, which affects electricity demand. By comparison, hybrid electric vehicles consume liquid fuels and do not connect to the grid. Hybrid vehicles were not eligible for any of the federal tax credits that expired in September 2025.

Between 2Q25 and 2Q26, hybrid electric vehicles continued to gain market share, reaching a record 16% of light-duty vehicle sales. The market shares of battery electric and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles decreased, according to estimates from Omdia. In 2Q26, battery electric vehicle sales were 6% of new light-duty vehicles sold, down from 7% in 2Q25; plug-in hybrid electric vehicle sales fell from 1.9% to 1.4% over the same period.
These different vehicle types affect the broader energy sector in different ways. Battery electric and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles can consume electricity from the grid, which affects electricity demand. By comparison, hybrid electric vehicles consume liquid fuels and do not connect to the grid. Hybrid vehicles were not eligible for any of the federal tax credits that expired in September 2025.
